name: Calendly
summary: Share booking links and keep track of meetings booked through Calendly.

triggers.name: Booking cancelled
triggers.description: A guest cancelled a meeting (webhook invitee.canceled).

actions.name: Read Calendly profile
actions.description: Reads the connected Calendly user and organisation.

actions.name: List meeting types
actions.description: Lists the meeting types people can book.

actions.name: Check booking availability
actions.description: Lists open times for a meeting type in a date range (at most 7 days).

actions.name: Create a booking link
actions.description: Creates a single-use booking link for a meeting type, to share with one person.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Page token returned by the previous call

actions.name: List meeting guests
actions.description: Lists the people booked into a meeting, with their answers to booking questions.

actions.name: Cancel a booked meeting
actions.description: Cancels a booked meeting and notifies the guests.

actions.name: Mark a guest as no-show
actions.description: Marks a guest as not having attended a meeting.
